decisions.statement: A transcript is folded from where the last fold stopped rather than from its first byte.
A file that no longer reads the way that file did is folded again from its first byte.
A fold starting again drops the state the old fold knew rather than merging into that old fold.
A cursor already naming another file keeps its state and consults no book.
A banked offset is taken together with the anchor and the state or not taken at all.
An agent already read on one path is not read again anywhere below itself.
A row naming an agent already above that row is drawn with nothing.
A subagent is descended into five deep and no deeper.
A subagent naming no id that subagent runs under is descended into no further.
What finished under a seat is answered from that seat's fold and every fold beside it.
A subagent one subagent dispatched has its finish recorded in the fold of whatever dispatched it.
A fold is read for what finished though whatever it folds has itself finished.
A folder that will not open leaves the seat's own fold as the whole answer.
An id any fold reads as running is dropped from what the folds read as finished.
A reading of a seat answers what runs under it and what has finished under it.
A reading gathers what finished from every transcript that reading descends into.
A subagent a running subagent finished is therefore answered as finished.
Both answers come from one fold of the seat's transcript.
A cursor no read touched is dropped.
The fold is banked at most once in ten seconds.
A bank that fails costs a refold rather than a wrong row.
The bank is awaited.
A host reading the fleet once and exiting still banks.
A line that is no JSON object changes nothing.

definition: the subagents running under each seat, folded out of the bytes each transcript gained
